# Figure 2A. Phylum-level relative abundance

This script generates a stacked area plot showing the relative abundance of the
top 10 phyla across samples from the WM, NM, and BM groups. Low-abundance phyla
are combined into the "Others" category.

## Input files

Place the following files in the same directory as this R Markdown file:

- `bracken.P.0.2`: Bracken phylum-level abundance table.
- `metadata.txt`: sample metadata containing at least the columns `Samples` and `Group`.

The metadata file should be tab-delimited and have a format similar to:

| Samples | Group |
|:--|:--|
| S1 | WM |
| S2 | NM |
| S3 | BM |

## Load packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
```

## 1. Read abundance table and metadata

```{r read-data}
species <- read.delim(
  "bracken.P.0.2",
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)

metadata <- read.delim(
  "metadata.txt",
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t",
  check.names = FALSE
)

group_df <- metadata %>%
  select(Samples, Group) %>%
  rename(Sample = Samples) %>%
  filter(Sample %in% colnames(species))

group_df$Group <- factor(
  group_df$Group,
  levels = c("WM", "NM", "BM")
)
```

## 2. Select the top 10 phyla and combine the remaining phyla

```{r select-phyla}
species_df <- species %>%
  rownames_to_column("phylum")

phylum_clean <- species_df %>%
  mutate(total = rowSums(across(-phylum))) %>%
  arrange(desc(total)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  select(-total)

others <- species_df %>%
  filter(!phylum %in% phylum_clean$phylum) %>%
  summarise(across(-phylum, sum)) %>%
  mutate(phylum = "Others")

phylum_data <- bind_rows(phylum_clean, others)
```

## 3. Calculate relative abundance

```{r relative-abundance}
df_phylum <- phylum_data %>%
  mutate(across(-phylum, ~ .x / sum(.x))) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -phylum,
    names_to = "Sample",
    values_to = "Abundance"
  ) %>%
  left_join(group_df, by = "Sample") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Group))
```

## 4. Order samples within each group

Samples are ordered by the relative abundance of Actinomycetota within each
group.

```{r sample-order}
target_phylum <- "Actinomycetota"

sample_order_df <- df_phylum %>%
  filter(phylum == target_phylum) %>%
  arrange(Group, desc(Abundance)) %>%
  distinct(Group, Sample)

sample_order <- sample_order_df$Sample

df_phylum$Sample <- factor(
  df_phylum$Sample,
  levels = sample_order
)
```

## 5. Define phylum and group colors

```{r colors}
color_map <- c(
  "Actinomycetota"  = "#3288bd",
  "Pseudomonadota"  = "#66c2a5",
  "Bacillota"       = "#9e0142",
  "Bacteroidota"    = "#fdae61",
  "Streptophyta"    = "#d53e4f",
  "Fusobacteriota"  = "#abdda4",
  "Euryarchaeota"   = "#f46d43",
  "Cyanobacteriota" = "#E9792F",
  "Apicomplexa"     = "#ffffbf",
  "Mycoplasmatota"  = "#F6C8A8",
  "Others"          = "#BDBDBD"
)

Treatments_colors <- c(
  "WM" = "#dfc27d",
  "NM" = "#bf812d",
  "BM" = "#543005"
)
```

## 6. Create the group annotation bars

```{r annotation-function}
plot_top_bar <- function(group_name, color_map_treat) {

  n_samples <- sum(group_df$Group == group_name)

  bar_data <- data.frame(
    x = seq_len(n_samples),
    y = 1,
    Group = factor(
      group_name,
      levels = names(color_map_treat)
    )
  )

  ggplot(
    bar_data,
    aes(x = x, y = y, fill = Group)
  ) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_map_treat) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 0, b = 5, l = 0),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}
```

## 7. Create the stacked area plots

```{r area-function}
plot_musk_area <- function(
  group_name,
  data,
  color_vec,
  position = "middle"
) {

  sub_data <- data %>%
    filter(Group == group_name)

  sub_data$phylum <- factor(
    sub_data$phylum,
    levels = names(color_vec)
  )

  sub_data$x_numeric <- as.numeric(sub_data$Sample)

  p <- ggplot(
    sub_data,
    aes(
      x = x_numeric,
      y = Abundance,
      fill = phylum,
      group = phylum
    )
  ) +
    geom_area(
      position = "fill",
      alpha = 0.85,
      colour = NA
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = color_vec,
      name = "Phylum",
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = c(0, 0),
      labels = percent
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x = element_line(colour = "black"),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    )

  if (position == "left") {

    p <- p +
      labs(y = "Relative Abundance") +
      theme(
        axis.line.y = element_line(colour = "black")
      )

  } else {

    p <- p +
      theme(
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y = element_blank()
      )
  }

  return(p)
}
```

## 8. Generate plots for the WM, NM, and BM groups

```{r generate-plots}
t_WM <- plot_top_bar("WM", Treatments_colors)
a_WM <- plot_musk_area(
  "WM",
  df_phylum,
  color_map,
  position = "left"
)

t_NM <- plot_top_bar("NM", Treatments_colors)
a_NM <- plot_musk_area(
  "NM",
  df_phylum,
  color_map,
  position = "middle"
)

t_BM <- plot_top_bar("BM", Treatments_colors)
a_BM <- plot_musk_area(
  "BM",
  df_phylum,
  color_map,
  position = "middle"
)
```

## 9. Combine the plots

```{r combine-plots}
col_WM <- t_WM / a_WM +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.4, 20))

col_NM <- t_NM / a_NM +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.4, 20))

col_BM <- t_BM / a_BM +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.4, 20))

final_plot <- (col_WM | col_NM | col_BM) +
  plot_layout(
    guides = "collect",
    widths = c(10, 9, 11)
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.spacing = unit(0, "cm")
  )

final_plot
```

## 10. Export the figure

```{r export-figure, eval=FALSE}
ggsave(
  "Figure2A_Phylum_Relative_Abundance.pdf",
  final_plot,
  width = 12,
  height = 6,
  device = grDevices::cairo_pdf
)

ggsave(
  "Figure2A_Phylum_Relative_Abundance.tiff",
  final_plot,
  width = 12,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300,
  compression = "lzw"
)
```

## 11. Export group mean relative abundance

The mean and standard deviation are calculated across samples within each group.

```{r group-mean}
group_mean <- df_phylum %>%
  group_by(Group, phylum) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Mean = Mean * 100,
    SD = SD * 100
  )

write.csv(
  group_mean,
  "Group_mean_relative_abundance_long.csv",
  row.names = FALSE,
  quote = FALSE
)

group_mean_wide <- group_mean %>%
  select(phylum, Group, Mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Group,
    values_from = Mean
  )

write.csv(
  group_mean_wide,
  "Group_mean_relative_abundance_wide.csv",
  row.names = FALSE,
  quote = FALSE
)

print(group_mean_wide)
```

## 12. Calculate overall relative abundance

```{r overall-abundance}
overall_mean <- df_phylum %>%
  group_by(phylum) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Mean = Mean * 100,
    SD = SD * 100
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Mean))

write.csv(
  overall_mean,
  "Overall_relative_abundance.csv",
  row.names = FALSE,
  quote = FALSE
)

print(overall_mean)
```
